facts.text: I want to search for Jupyter Notebooks that deal with spatial modeling.
My specific problem involves observing a 100 by 100 grid of cells changing under application of specific rules.
My example rule is: for each plot of trees, let it grow to the east by one column every five time steps.
I want a Python program that creates a 100 x 100 grid.
I want the program to randomly assign several groups of 250 contiguous cells to Python objects.
I want to assign features to the objects, including color.
I want to assign features to the objects, including soil_type.
I want to assign features to the objects, including humidity.
I want to assign features to the objects, including speed_to_grow.
I want to assign features to the objects, including unique_id.
I want to assign features to the objects, including unique_id_of_all_neighbors.
In the program that generates a grid, I want to print the (x,y) values of the groups.
I want a 2D picture of the grid showing the locations of the groups.
I want the picture of the locations of the groups to be generated possibly with matplotlib.
